    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.stk ORDER BY (x.a08 - x.a09) DESC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT f.stk AS stk, c.pck AS pck, c.pc_nm AS pc_nm,
      sumIf(f.amt1, toYear(f.dk) = 2008) AS a08,
      sumIf(f.amt1, toYear(f.dk) = 2009) AS a09
    FROM l0.fct_sls f
    INNER JOIN l0.d_prd p ON p.prk = f.prk
    INNER JOIN l0.d_prd_sub ps ON ps.psck = p.psck
    INNER JOIN l0.d_prd_cat c ON c.pck = ps.pck
    WHERE toYear(f.dk) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY f.stk, c.pck, c.pc_nm
  ) x
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT stk AS stk, sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2008) AS a08, sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2009) AS a09,
      sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2009) - sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2008) AS dlt,
      (sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2009) - sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2008)) / sumIf(amt1, toYear(dk) = 2008) AS chg,

    FROM l0.fct_sls

  SELECT f.csk, d.c_yr AS yr, sum(f.amt1) AS amt
  FROM l0.fct_ol_sls f
  JOIN l0.d_dt d ON f.dk = d.dk
  WHERE d.c_yr IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY f.csk, d.c_yr
), p AS (
  SELECT csk,
         sumIf(amt, yr = 2008) AS amt_2008,
         sumIf(amt, yr = 2009) AS amt_2009
  FROM y
  GROUP BY csk
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (p.amt_2009 - p.amt_2008) / p.amt_2008 DESC) AS `名次`,
       if(c.fnm = 'Not Provided' OR c.lnm = 'Not Provided', toString(c.csk), concat(c.fnm, ' ', c.lnm)) AS `客户`,

       round(p.amt_2008, 2) AS `消费额_2008`,
       round(p.amt_2009, 2) AS `消费额_2009`,

       round((p.amt_2009 - p.amt_2008) / p.amt_2008 * 100, 2) AS `增长率_百分比`
FROM p
JOIN l0.d_cst c ON p.csk = c.csk
WHERE p.amt_2008 > 0
